name: Receiving Workflow
summary: Primary guided, manual, and edit receiving flow with settings-driven startup, validation gates, module-scoped unsaved state, weak-event workflow notifications, final save orchestration, completion actions that either start a fresh entry at the correct mode-specific step or return directly to mode selection, guided-step focus restoration when reused workflow hosts are re-entered, runtime-configurable keyboard shortcuts, shared MainWindow pane-footer label actions that open the configured Receiving Label and Mini-Receiving Label templates through Windows shell shortcut-style behavior after validating both the LabelView executable path and the selected label path, a Ctrl+T simple-navigation override for Next and Back, Manual Mode part-first or PO-first part/PO resolution, textbox-based Manual Mode location entry, a Guided Mode recommended-locations card driven by current InforVisual stock evidence and the user ignore list, package-type updates for Manual Mode rows, a pre-review non-PO reference dialog that supports reusable saved entries plus per-part remembered defaults with overwrite confirmation, a mode-selection action that reconciles saved MTM loads against InforVisual receipt history, current inventory totals, and transaction-history smart-fix evidence while requiring exact quantity matches unless one destination location holds the full matched same-day transfer quantity for the receipt group, resolving transfer destinations from the paired InforVisual movement, excluding same-location matches from review, and falling back to WC when history proves work-center transfer plus full adjustment-out, a hosted reconciliation review step that presents proposed changes before any row is updated, user-scoped reconciliation preferences that can ignore configured locations during automatic review and recommendation display, a JSON-backed mock Infor Visual catalog plus runtime transaction store for default PO and location behavior, mock-mode save writes that preserve whole-load quantities while aggregating mocked destination totals by location, PO-assisted part ordering that prioritizes earlier expected receive dates before mostly satisfied lines, and PO due-date persistence that prefers the selected line-level date before falling back to the PO header promise date.
